baseline: Euclidean inverse-square IDW50 of training transformed targets. Use all coincident training points when distance=0, otherwise50 nearest with sample-ID Unicode ordering for ties. Weights(nearestDistance/distance)^2 normalized. No refit on validation.
candidate: One geology residual IDW50. Global training mean m, class mean(sum(z_class)+20*m)/(n_class+20); null/unseen->m. Add query class mean to IDW50 of training residuals using identical baseline neighbors/weights. Clip below log1p(0.01). No class merging, feature selection, parameter search or extra candidates.50neighbors/shrinkage20 retained from previously committed model family; consumed soil/BC audits are not retuned.
cohort: Retain all2820 rows in inventory, sourceRow/ID/coordinates unchanged. Only metadata-based spatial buffer exclusions may remove evaluation membership. No concentration-dependent exclusion. Unique IDs/count agreement do not resolve QC-parent lineage; ~20-21m field duplicates are bounded by5km cross-partition separation, with same-partition dependence unresolved.
deviationPolicy: Reserve whole raw release once. No replacement audit/new ID/source normalization after exposure. Stop on scientific-method changes or failed preflight. Preserve every failure. No source admission, model improvement or supply forecast inferred from preparation.
evaluation: Sample-weighted transformed RMSE primary; MAE secondary. Evaluate fixed candidate on audit once even if validation fails.2,000 paired20km audit-group bootstrap draws, sorted groups, NumPy2.5.3 PCG64(20261024), whole groups with replacement, original sample multiplicities, linear2.5th/97.5th percentiles. Undefined zero-baseline draws counted, never redrawn; any makes interval inconclusive. Both validation/audit relative RMSE gains>=0.02 and95% audit lower bound>0 required for numerical gate. No automatic scientific promotion or learned research-policy claim.
execution: Freeze exact memberships, target-free inventory, numerical evaluator and raw release before labels. Future reviewed adapter must reproduce metadata/geology from exact inputs, verify all hashes/runtime/plan, decode only columnK, fit training only, seal all model/predictions then consume audit before metrics. Registry generic checks alone do not establish this. Binding the target-free inventory is not binding a target dataset. No scoring entry point is implemented by this increment.
exposureAtLocalCommitment: Before commitment:2820 IDs/coordinates,2817 unique interior joins/3 unmatched, schemas/licences/method/LLD documentation, pH-conditioning coefficients, QC incident counts, boron contents heading. No Cu cells, range/distribution/maps, row censor flags, predictions or metrics. Old soil and BC outcomes exposed/consumed. Local timestamps are self-reported, not external blinding.
nextStep: This design is stopped. Preserve the five-group validation failure, all original memberships and the unchanged method. No target decoding, audit, relaxed gate or replacement split is authorized by this record.

predictors: Easting/northing in published EPSG2157 and exact UNITNAME for unique interior polygon matches. Null for missing/boundary/overlap. Missing and unseen geology use global training mean. No AGE BRACKET, boundary-distance, pH, other assay, ID or sourceRow predictor. No nearest geometry fallback.
projection: Reviewed design, source provenance and aggregate metadata readiness counts. Site memberships, sample IDs, assay cells and internal paths are not exported.
provenance: GSI/GSNI500k map publication and temporal end2013-12-18, edition2018; package/DBF2024. Not authenticated pre-2020 bytes.100k map not used because its lineage explicitly incorporates Tellus geochemistry. No proven absence of later G7/G9-related updates claimed for500k. Interpreted bedrock is not measured shallow-soil lithology. Regional land-use-selected sampling is not representative global discovery evidence.20km groups/5km buffer do not prove absence of wider autocorrelation.

readiness.interpretation: Descriptive accounting of the same failed metadata allocation, not a retry or alternate split. No assay, prediction, score or measured model improvement. Do not change fixed design to pass.

scope: Retrospective geographic validation conditional on a publisher-dated 1:500,000 map. No historical hindcast, external blinding, total-copper, ore-discovery, depth, reserves or deliverable-supply claim.

softwareVerification.meaning: Synthetic contract tests only; not a real model result.

split.bufferRule: Original held-out points remain buffer references even when validation membership is later removed. Exclude train if distance<5000m to original validation/audit, validation if distance<5000m to original audit. Never remove audit. Record originalPartition and exclusion; keep every row.
split.failure: Stop without changing grid, salt, origin, source, target, buffer or thresholds. No repeated allocation search.

target: Cu_mgkg_ICPar, sheet6175xxA-6307xxA columnK, mg/kg. Natural log1p(max(reported numeric value,0.01)). Below-LLD source values are half-LLD substituted; evaluate only this floor-capped reporting signal. Never infer row censor flags from equality to0.005. Any missing, text, nonfinite or negative value stops the entire experiment without dropping rows or resplitting. Nominal survey0.05-0.20m is not measured per-row depth; five-auger composite, <2mm milled fraction, partial aqua-regia ICP-AES/MS.
timing: The design timestamp precedes the metadata allocation check. The archived record includes that later failed check. Both local times are self-reported; registry recording and publication happen later and do not establish external blinding.
